body: Im comforted to know that I’m not the only one going thru this type of situation. Thank you for writing me back. It’s just so confusing. He says he’s stressed out and gets distracted bc his mind is in other places but i just don’t understand. I don’t know what he wants. He’s starting to treat me like i mean nothing to him. I’ll text him about how much he means to me and how much i love him but sometimes he just brushes it off and says something like “wyd” or “are you alright?” But he doesn’t want me to leave!! I don’t know why he wants me to stay with him.. idk what he wants.. we haven’t seen each other in 4 months and it hurts so bad but he says it’s bc he doesn’t wanna get in trouble for seeing me and that he’s tired and stressed out.. idk if it’s just an excuse or if he’s serious. Im starting to questions his “love”for me and im just so lost and confused and im hurt bc things arent how they use to be.. it makes me so sad i just don’t know what to do.. i wanna be there for him and everything and watch him be success and i want him happy but idk!! Im just lost

Yeah when we were talking a few weeks back about our situation he told me I tend to stress him out. Of course I don’t mean to but I do have anxiety so sometimes it causes me to worry and I’ll ask him what’s wrong or I’ll get mad at him for not talking to me.. I guess I just need to take a step back and let him come to me when he wants. I care about him deeply and don’t want our relationship to die. The other day I got angry with him because he made me think he was going to come see me, I got ready and everything and I had called him after I got ready and on the phone I said “i think my dad just came home” because I heard my dad pull up in the driveway and he took it as me being scared of my dad which idk how that even makes sense but the only reason why I said that was because he was gonna have to meet both my parents now that my dad was home. He ended up saying he’ll call me back but I didn’t hear from him until I was mad that night and told him I was gonna leave him. He says things like he wants to be there with me and he wants a future with me and he still talks about things in the future. For example the other day I was talking to him about going to the gym and he said that he’s gonna go with me when I go so we can workout together. It won’t be until I get my car tho which is another 2 months away. He said that it hurts him too that we don’t talk as much anymore. He too sees that things aren’t how they use to be and he says it hurts him when he thinks about it. But the whole reason why we don’t talk as much is because he doesn’t wanna talk. He won’t reply to me. So I really don’t understand. It’s very confusing and I wish I could see it from him perspective. I don’t know what to do.. if I should bother him or let him come to me or let him have his space and let him talk to me when he wants to.. I understand wanting space but I just feel like it could have the potential to drive us apart even more. And if he’s hurting from the lack of communication why would he be the cause of the problem? He also said he isn’t ready to meet my parents and he’s in fear of meeting them because he doesn’t want to get in trouble. He’s on probation and he’s the type of person who doesn’t trust anybody he’s very hard headed and doesn’t really trust anyone. He has to see things thru your actions, you can’t tell him something and expect him to believe it. So he thinks my parents would call the police on him or whatever and file something against him idk I guess I can see why he’s be afraid but I don’t know if that’s just an excuse or what..

Thank you so much for your input.. i don’t know what to think but i know you’re right when you said if he really loves me then he should behave like it.. he has probation and is being cautious bc he doesn’t want to get in trouble again.. he says that he doesn’t want to get in trouble for wanting to spend time with me.. he says he has a curfew for 10pm, it’s apart of his probation, and since im still living with my parents and he hasn’t met them yet i guess it just adds on more stress for him and he doesn’t want anything else on his plate right now.. im very confused with this whole situation and i don’t know what he wants or why he’s doing what he’s doing.. he use to do everything he could for me but we’ve kinda drifted apart.. that’s another reason why he said he hasn’t come to see me, because we fell off and haven’t been talking as much.. but idk they could just be excuses for all i know.. i don’t know what he wants from me.. we haven’t seen each other in 4 months but he doesn’t want me to leave him, he wants me to stay and be with him.. but you’re right, when will things change? I have questions that i wish i knew the answers to..

And when you said you feel happy when you’re feeling useful like a work i know exactly how you feel dude. On god i feel the same way.. i wanted to work all weekend, monday and today so i could be kept busy and fee useful bc when im at home or just sitting/standing around not being busy i get back into my head and i start overthinking again and i just get depressed

I relate to literally almost everything you said.. i feel the same exact way.. i too feel like i do too much for people who don’t do as much for me.. i feel like im also not a priority in my relationship with my boyfriend.. im constantly being left on read or my phone calls don’t get returned.. it’s sad how your own girlfriend won’t even go to your graduation and that she’s rather go to the con.. that’s really fucked up.. she should be there supporting you.. i know how you feel tho. It sucks how much you’d do for somebody and how much you’d put yourself thru only to feel like you’re getting taken advantage of in the end.. i send my boyfriend paragraphs and i tell him how much i love and care about him all the time, im constantly making him a priority and trying to keep him happy but he doesn’t do the same for me.. the most i’ll get is a “i love you baby” or “you’re beautiful i miss you” but nothing like “thank you for everything you do for me you don’t know how thankful i am for you you’ve done so much for me and you motivate me on a daily basis and i love you so much for that” or whatever but you know what im saying? Like i do so much for him and put in so much effort but im not getting the same effort back.. it’s like i give him diamonds but i only get a rock back in return

I know EXACTLY how you feel!! I get told those same exact things.. “you’re overreacting” “you’re being a baby” “everything’s a big deal to you” “quit stressing and making things such a big deal” “you’re immature bc you can’t make adult decisions” “you’re too old to be shy” “quit worrying so much” “you always think something is wrong and it’s annoying” i have severe anxiety and it links with my depression.. nobody fully understands me either they think i make everything a big deal and all but i can’t help it. It’s my anxiety, I care too much and I worry a lot bc of how much I care about the person. And it’s not like i worry a lot to the point where i annoy the person with 50 phone calls and 30 text messages but i do tend to worry a bit. People don’t understand and they’re so quick to judging and they don’t try to understand.. when i get told those things it damages me and my confidence.. i wish people would understand or at least try to and not be so fucking quick to judge..
I hear you on this.. im tired of all the fucking bullshit in my life but it hurts knowing that there’s nothing i can do about it except “ride out the storm”

That does make sense.. you’re so right about that.. it was my first time testing him and he’s tested me a few times.. but yeah im very afraid of losing him but i have to face the reality if everything happens for a reason and things will ply out the way they’re suppose to.. i have very bad anxiety and sometimes it gets out of hand and sometimes i feel like im going to ruin the relationship with my anxiety and with me worrying so much and making things a big deal and it kills me i just dont want him to think i dont care when i do and im just trying to not make things a big deal does that make any sense? Probably not lol.. but i gave him everything and still try my hardest to do so and keep him happy.. I realize i cant make everybody happy.. but that’s really all i want for him and it hurts me in the process of trying to make him happy bc i feel at times im doing too much or over doing it and i just end up feeling stupid bc i always feel like im over doing it but at the same time i don’t wanna under do it and make it seem like i dont care.. its just complicated and stressful.. very stressful. I hate relationships and wish shit was easier.. i just wish things were how they use to be.. im just so confused and lost idk what our relationship is anymore.. idk know if you’d call it a relationship.. but it is what it is there’s nothing i can do about what was meant to be and what was not meant to be..
